title: Application Security Engineer
description: ABOUT PAYSTACK Paystack’s mission is to help merchants in Africa get paid by anyone, anywhere in the world. Tens of thousands of notable corporations and businesses in Africa use Paystack’s modern payments infrastructure, including MTN, Bolt, Domino’s Pizza, Smile Communications, AXA Mansard Insurance, and many others. Within over 9 years, our close-knit team has introduced a steady cadence of innovations within the African Payment space, such as automated recurring payments, the ability for customers to pay with only a bank account, automated chargebacks, and much more. We process well over $300 million in transactions monthly, and our double-digit growth has us processing even more every month. We’ve pioneered a new era of simple, powerful technology tools for businesses in Africa, and as we prepare for a period of accelerated growth, we’re looking to you to help build a solid foundation upon which we can support some of the continent’s best-performing businesses. At Paystack, we believe that we will win by recruiting talented people and giving them the space, resources, and support to do the best work of their lives. We hire the most capable people, treat them with genuine respect, and give them the means to succeed. And we’d love your help! As a leader of the Information Security function at Paystack, you will contribute to the business by presenting your technical expertise with a balanced approach to communication and a bias for action. You will be required to work with our leadership teams at all levels of the company to drive solutions that impact our platform for the good of Paystack and ultimately, our customers and stakeholders. You will leverage your experience across various tools and processes to establish policies and standards across the company. WHAT YOU’LL DO We're looking for an intermediate Application Security Engineer to join our Information Security Team. This is your chance to play a critical role in securing Paystack's rapidly growing fintech platform and ensuring that our customers' trust remains unwavering. You'll work closely with our Engineering, DevOps, and Product teams to safeguard our applications from design to deployment. From penetration testing and vulnerability management to building a culture of secure development, you'll be the expert who ensures security is embedded into everything we build. If you're passionate about protecting systems, love a technical challenge, and thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment — this role was made for you. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES As an Application Security Engineer/Analyst, you will be a key contributor to our security posture, working closely with engineering and product teams. Your responsibilities will include: - Application Security Testing: Conduct web and mobile application security assessments and API security testing. Perform threat modelling, secure code reviews, and attack surface analysis. Support SAST and DAST initiatives. - Vulnerability Management: Assist in managing the vulnerability lifecycle. Coordinate internal and external security assessments, ensuring proper scoping and timely delivery. Track and report on remediation progress. - Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) Integration: Ensure secure coding practices are followed. Collaborate with developers, testers, and business analysts to provide proactive security guidance during development sprints. Contribute to security frameworks, checklists, and guidelines (aligned with OWASP, NIST, MITRE). Work on DevSecOps testing and protective controls. - Incident Response Support: Assist in the investigation and resolution of application security incidents. Contribute to post-incident analysis and implement preventative measures. - Continuous Improvement & Innovation: Stay informed about cybersecurity trends, emerging threats, and attack vectors. Research and contribute to the implementation of innovative security solutions. Identify process improvements to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of security assessments. WHO YOU ARE A few things we expect you should have to be able to meet the demands of the role include: - Minimum 3 years in application security, IT security, or software development with a security focus - Hands-on experience with penetration testing, vulnerability assessments, and secure code reviews - Proven experience with SAST, DAST, and threat modelling frameworks - Practical knowledge of secure software development practices (OWASP Top 10, CWE) - Hands-on development experience or scripting ability (Python, JavaScript, Bash) - Strong understanding of web application security, API security, and cloud security concepts (AWS, Azure, or GCP) - Understanding of DevSecOps principles and CI/CD security integration - Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex security concepts to technical and non-technical audiences - Collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally BENEFITS - Competitive compensation package and benefits - Stripe Equity compensation - Full medical coverage - Wellbeing stipend - Generous leave and sabbatical policies - Hybrid working environment - Smart, kind colleagues who’re invested in your growth. Paystack is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We’re committed to providing employees with a work environment that is progressive and open-minded. Our employment philosophy is to hire the best people and empower them to do the best work of their lives. Employment decisions are based on business needs and individual merit without regard to race, colour, religion, ethnicity, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, gender or age.

title: Debt Collection Process Lead
description: ABOUT THE COMPANY Mogo is Kenya's fast-scaling fintech - part of Eleving Group, a global financial services platform operating across 16+ countries. We are redefining access to vehicle financing, microfinance, and smartphone financing for everyday Kenyans. Our mission is simple: make progress accessible. We are dedicated to fostering upward social mobility in diverse communities by providing credit access to entrepreneurs who are often excluded from traditional banking. Through a combination of asset financing, fintech innovations, AI-based underwriting, and proprietary car portals, we empower local entrepreneurs, such as motorcycle taxi riders, Uber/Bolt drivers, and small business owners, to purchase their own vehicles and obtain loans to expand their businesses. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a data-driven and hands-on Debt Collection Process Lead to design, optimize, and manage end-to-end collections workflows for vehicle and device finance in Kenya. In this role, you will lead initiatives that strengthen the customer repayment experience while ensuring collections operations remain efficient, compliant, and scalable. On a day-to-day basis, you will work closely with the Head of Debt Collection and partner teams across Credit/Risk, Customer Service, Product/IT, and Legal to turn data insights into operational improvements. This is a high-impact role for someone who is proactive, structured, and takes full ownership. WHAT YOU WILL DO 1. Process design & optimization - Design and continuously improve consumer collections processes across all delinquency stages - Introduce and scale automation (case allocation rules, workflows, customer communications) and explore robotics/AI use cases to improve efficiency and cost-to-collect. - Audit current workflows, improve them end-to-end (test and implement changes), and design new processes where needed. 2. Documentation & training - Create and maintain SOPs, playbooks, and training materials to ensure consistent execution across internal teams and external partners (if applicable). - Support onboarding and continuous training for collections agents and related stakeholders. 3. Cross-functional delivery - Partner with Customer Service, Credit/Risk, Product/IT, Legal, and any BPO/agency partners to implement data-driven collections improvements. - Coordinate testing and rollouts of new strategies, communications, tooling changes, and policy updates. 4. Continuous improvement - Use customer feedback, agent input, and performance analytics to identify bottlenecks (e.g., contractability, broken PTP, queue management, dispute handling). - Propose improvements, drive execution, and track impact through clear initiatives and timelines. 5. title: Head of Engineering & Data
description: ABOUT THE COMPANY Nuru Solutions is an agricultural data company. We combine satellite imagery, weather data, ground-truth field data, and machine learning to give insurers and lenders the farm-level intelligence they need to serve smallholder farmers well, including yield prediction, crop monitoring, and risk profiling across Kenya, Malawi, and Somalia. Our work has served tens of thousands of farmers, and our mission is to empower farmers and pastoralists with the climate resilience and access to finance they need to thrive. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a technical leader to architect and execute the technology strategy that will power Nuru's growth. You will transform our core web platform into a suite of scalable, multi-channel products, including field-team mobile tools and farmer outreach channels, and lead all aspects of technology, data, and product development. You will be a core part of the team that turns our data and models into scalable, revenue-generating products. This is a leadership role first: you will spend most of your time setting direction, unblocking, and growing the team. But you remain hands-on and technical enough to make the hard architectural calls yourself, strategize with the CEO, translate client and farmer needs into technical specs, and hold a high bar on what ships. The role has a clear growth path as the company scales. Your first-year scorecard is unambiguous: automate our ML and data pipelines to reduce human-in-the-loop refinement, improve margins, upgrade to commercial-grade infrastructure, and enable the platform to scale without linear headcount growth while keeping our models credible, our data governed, and our IP secure. WHAT YOU WILL DO CORE RESPONSIBILITIES: 1. Technology & Architectural Strategy - Lead all development of tech, data, software, and web-based products, including liaising with external teams when necessary. - Own, define, plan, and execute Nuru’s end-to-end technology vision and roadmap in alignment with business objectives and growth strategy. - Lead the implementation of Nuru’s database and cloud architecture, model development, and data pipeline development, including satellite index integration, ML models, and climate data pipelines. - Design scalable, cost-efficient, secure, and resilient systems for data ingestion, storage, analytics, and distribution, with cost discipline appropriate to an early-stage company on a defined path to breakeven. - Lead the automation of Nuru's ML and data pipelines to reduce manual intervention, improve unit economics, and allow the platform to scale without proportional headcount growth. - Design and lead software development cycles from prototyping to deployment, ensuring rapid iteration based on user feedback. - Ensure integration of farmer- and field-facing channels (SMS, WhatsApp, mobile) with backend analytics systems. - Prioritize product development based on client needs, available resources, and Nuru's business strategy. 2. Product Development and Execution: - Champion collaboration with the CEO and Operations lead to ensure technical feasibility and operational fit of product innovation - Lead the full software development evolution for Nuru's core web app and future platforms, from prototyping and iteration to deployment and monitoring. - Direct the development and integration of core technical capabilities, including ML models for yield prediction and risk profiling - Stay up to date on AI/ML and other relevant advancements in yield prediction, risk profiling, and the agricultural and insuretech industries to inform future Nuru product offerings. 3. IP Custody & Engineering Standards - Own cloud environments and IP custody standards. All work - internal and contractor - is developed, stored, and accepted within Nuru-controlled infrastructure, verified at every milestone as a hard acceptance condition. - Structure external engagements as fixed-fee, milestone-based task orders with explicit acceptance criteria, and enforce them. - Maintain high standards of code quality, system reliability, and performance through robust documentation, testing, and DevOps practices. 4. Data and Analytics - Define and own the company’s data strategy, including the creation of robust automated pipelines for the collection, processing, and analysis of diverse datasets; satellite, weather, and ground-truth field data. - Full responsibility to develop, implement, and monitor a scalable data pipeline and systems to maintain the utmost data quality, integrity, and usability: i.e. validate satellite/GIS/weather data accuracy and ground-truthing processes. - Uphold and operationalize Nuru's two-stage model validation protocol, ensuring internal holdout results and independent field-validation results are tracked separately, and only approved metrics are reported externally. - Ensure data accuracy is continuously measured and transparently tracked across the company, including validation of satellite, GIS, and weather data against ground-truthing processes. - Champion integration of partner and field-team inputs to ensure smooth incorporation of external datasets. 5. Team Management - Recruit, mentor, and manage Nuru’s tech and data teams, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and accountability. - Build capacity in-house for critical technical and data analysis skills, , reducing dependency on external contractors over time. - Supervise dev and data teams, including internal and external teams; ensure clear communication of blockers to the CEO and implications on implementation workflows to the operations lead. 6. Cross-Functional & Strategic Leadership - Partner with the CEO to evaluate new market opportunities, inform strategic decisions with technical feasibility, and represent technology in investor communications. - Partner with the operations lead to define data requirements for field collection, provide technical inputs for grant and investor reporting, and ensure smooth operational integration of new features. - Act as the key technical advisor to the leadership team, translating complex technical concepts into clear business implications for non-technical stakeholders. - Support business development and marketing efforts by providing technical depth in client and partner discussions, demonstrations, and content. - Legal and Compliance: Ensure compliance with data privacy, security, and protection laws in all jurisdictions where Nuru operates. WHAT YOU HAVE Must-Haves (Required) - 7+ years in software engineering, with 3+ years leading engineers. You have owned architecture and delivery for production systems at scale, not just prototypes. - Deep, hands-on software development and system design expertise. You can still read a pull request, make an architectural call, and set technical standards, even though your primary job is to lead. - A proven track record of building and scaling cloud-native platforms (AWS preferred), including data pipelines, APIs, and multi-channel product delivery across web, mobile, and messaging. - Experience shipping AI/ML-powered products. You do not need to build models yourself, but you must be fluent enough to architect systems around them, work credibly with data scientists, and set the bar for how models move from notebook to production. - Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous client and field needs into technical specs and a sequenced roadmap under real resource constraints. - Experience hiring, mentoring, and managing engineers and blended engineering/data teams. Strongly Preferred - Experience in agritech, insurtech, fintech, or geospatial and remote-sensing products. - Familiarity with GIS and satellite data or a demonstrated track record of ramping quickly into an unfamiliar data domain. - Startup or early-stage experience; comfortable being hands-on and building structure where little exists yet. HOW YOU WORK - You lead rather than default to doing everything yourself, but you are never far from the code. - You bridge engineering and data: able to earn the trust of data scientists while keeping the team focused on shippable, reliable product. - You treat IP custody, model governance, and documentation as professional standards, not overhead. - You communicate clearly, hold your own in investor, partner, and client conversations, and translate technical depth for non-technical audiences.

About the Company

Nuru Solutions is a B2B agricultural data intelligence platform operating across Kenya, Malawi, Nigeria, and Somalia. We combine satellite imagery, weather data, ground-truth and machine learning to deliver farm-level intelligence to insurers, lenders, and agribusinesses serving smallholder farmers.

Our platform powers six core analytical pillars: crop health monitoring, yield prediction, risk profiling, farm boundary detection, credit risk assessment, and market price forecasting. We achieve 80–98% accuracy through a hybrid approach that fuses multi-source satellite data, ML models, and validated ground-truth data, a combination that outperforms single-source competitors.

About the Role

Nuru is at an inflection point. We have validated product-market fit, a growing institutional pipeline, and proven model accuracy across multiple countries. Commercial activity to date has been founder-led.

That is the constraint we are now removing.

This is Nuru’s first dedicated commercial hire. The mandate is to take a validated product with demonstrated results and build a repeatable revenue engine around it — converting the existing institutional pipeline, systematically mapping the addressable market of lenders and insurers across our four countries, and establishing the qualification discipline, CRM foundation, and sales process the next stage of growth will be built on.

This person will be responsible for transforming Nuru’s commercial function from a founder-led, relationship-driven effort into a structured, forecastable, and scalable sales operation.

You will not be handed a playbook. You will write it.

What You Will Do

  1. Pipeline Generation & Market Mapping

    • Systematically map the addressable market of financial institutions across Kenya, Malawi, Nigeria and Somalia — identifying who lends to or insures smallholders, at what volume, with what risk problem, and who inside the institution owns that problem.

    • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline through structured outbound: targeted outreach, referral generation, and consistent follow-through against a defined activity model.

    • Prioritise ruthlessly — identifying which segments, institution types and geographies produce the shortest path to revenue, and concentrating effort accordingly.

  2. Sales Execution & Deal Ownership

    • Own the full sales cycle from origination through discovery, demonstration, technical validation, pilot design, commercial negotiation and close.

    • Deliver credible product demonstrations to sophisticated institutional buyers — credit, risk, underwriting and actuarial leads — translating model performance into commercial consequence: loss ratio, default rate, portfolio expansion, cost to serve.

    • Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder decision-making processes. Our sales cycles routinely involve credit, risk, operations, technology, procurement, and often a board or regulator. Building a coalition inside each account is the job, not an obstacle to it.

    • Structure and negotiate pilots and commercial agreements that convert into recurring revenue rather than stranding as unpaid proofs of concept.

  3. Commercial Infrastructure & Reporting

    • Own and operate Nuru’s CRM as a working system: accurate pipeline hygiene, stage discipline, and reliable forecasting.

    • Apply a consistent qualification framework across all opportunities so that pipeline reported to the CEO and board reflects reality.

    • Produce clear commercial reporting — pipeline coverage, conversion rates, cycle length, win/loss analysis — and use it to improve the process.

    • Build the assets the function will run on: outreach sequences, discovery frameworks, objection handling, pricing guidance, case materials.

  4. Market Intelligence & Stakeholder Communication

    • Act as the company’s ear in the market, feeding competitive intelligence, pricing signals and unmet needs back into product and pricing decisions.

    • Represent Nuru’s methodology and results accurately to institutional partners. Accuracy and performance claims must align with Nuru’s model validation standards — independently validated results only.

    • Represent Nuru at industry events, partner forums and investor-facing engagements alongside the CEO.

What You Have

Must-Haves (Required)

  • 5+ years of B2B business development or enterprise sales experience, with a demonstrated track record of carrying and hitting a number.

  • Experience selling to financial services clients — banks, MFIs, insurers, or fintechs. This is the single most important qualifier. You should already understand how these institutions buy, how long it takes, and who genuinely signs.

  • Proven experience demonstrating a product to clients and leading technical or solution-led sales conversations with credibility.

  • Demonstrated experience in market mapping and territory construction — building a target universe from first principles rather than working an inherited list.

  • Track record managing complex sales cycles and complex decision-making processes: long timelines, multiple stakeholders, procurement, phased commitments.

  • Fluent, disciplined use of a CRM as an operating tool, not an administrative afterthought.

  • Entrepreneurial, mature, and proactive. You will be the first commercial hire in a lean business. There is no support function to fall back on, no inherited process, and no one checking your calendar. You must set your own priorities, operate without supervision, and be honest about what is and isn’t working.

  • Strong upward management. You will report directly to the CEO. That means bringing solutions alongside problems, managing expectations proactively, and giving unvarnished visibility into pipeline reality — particularly when it is uncomfortable.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to hold a technical conversation and a commercial one in the same meeting.

Strongly Preferred

  • Working knowledge of the MEDDIC qualification framework (or equivalent — MEDDPICC, Command of the Message) and a habit of applying it rigorously.

  • Exposure to agriculture, agri-data, geospatial or climate risk. Genuinely advantageous, not required — we can teach the sector; we cannot teach commercial instinct.

  • Experience in early-stage or scale-up environments where you built the systems rather than inherited them.

  • Familiarity with credit risk, insurance, or financial product design in agricultural or development contexts.

  • Existing network across East, Southern, or West African financial services.

  • Willingness to travel across our four markets.

Why This Role is Unique

  1. You are the first. First commercial hire into a fast-growing business with a validated product. You will define how Nuru sells — the process, the messaging, the qualification standard, the CRM architecture. Few commercial people get the chance to build the function rather than inherit it.

  2. Direct access to the founder. You will work side by side with the CEO daily. No layers, no filtering, no waiting for decisions.

  3. A clear growth pathway. This role is the foundation of Nuru’s commercial function. The intention is that the person who builds it well grows with it, into leadership of the team that follows.

  4. Regional scope over time. We operate in four countries today. Commercial ownership of that regional footprint is a natural progression from this seat.

  5. A genuinely engaged advisory board. Nuru has assembled senior operators, investors and sector specialists at board level, and they are accessible. This is not a decorative board — it is a resource, and you will have direct exposure to and mentorship from people whose experience meaningfully complements the CEO’s.

  6. External validation. Recognised as one of the 30 most promising African startups, with 25,000 farmers served through our platform to date.
